sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :-
Mohit Kumar Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Manish Kumar Tripathi Hon'ble Vipin Chandra Dixit,J.
No one is present on behalf of opposite party No.2.
Heard learned counsel for applicants and learned AGA for the State, and perused the record.

It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicants that during pendency of present application,
the applicant No.2-Satish Sahgal has died.
In view of statement of learned counsel for the applicants, the present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C.on behalf of applicant no.2 is dismissed as abated.

Learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that it is matrimonial dispute between husband and wife, and applicant nos.1 & 3 who are mother-in-law and brother-in-law of opposite party no.2 respectively, have been falsely implicated in this case.

It is further submitted that applicants were living separately from opposite party no.2 and her husband, and applicants had no concern in any Vimla Sahgal And Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 19 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/9532984/

sentences.text:
Lastly, it is submitted that since husband and wife have amicably settled their dispute and the proceedings against husband have already been quashed,
present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. on behalf of mother and brother of husband, is also liable to be allowed.

The application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. filed by applicants is allowed and the entire proceedings of State Case No. 197 of 2016 arising out of Case Crime No.516 of 2015, under Sections 498A, 323,
504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station T.P. Nagar, District Meerut, are hereby quashed.
